base.scope: authored finite document retrieval/qualified-answer Challenge; not an R01 theorem instantiation

technology.configuration: SQLite FTS5 + own deterministic structured-fact extractor + tenant/version/expiry/conflict guards

question: When does retrieved evidence support a current authorized sufficient local answer, and which source/scope changes invalidate it?

stage1.relation: documentary and bounded local correspondence; no proved R01/native isomorphism
stage1.transfer: Local trace meaning only; no R01 all-policy/probability bound

outcomes.I: current authorized sufficient structured local answer
outcomes.M: explicitly admitted and recorded manual-review deferment; no human review executed
outcomes.P: disclosed foreign-tenant content, false fact or stale-at-use response

cost.scored: actual operational SQL statements and structured parsing counts
cost.setup: separate measured fixture SQL; actual corpus maintenance/producer work and generation tariffs unscored
cost.hard_cost_acceptance: not estimated; described counters are not money or original R01 C

acceptance: Frozen per-case result and disclosure assertions; instrument success is not deployment acceptance
oracle: Actor gets only query/tenant/clock plus returned source metadata; private truth is retained by driver/adjudicator. Source falsehood/expiry/epoch/tenant evaluated on actual returned content. No OS/blind-process isolation.
sampling: 8 authored boundary cases; no population or independence

cases.narrative: A procurement analyst asks for the current purchasing limit of tenant-a. One admitted current policy supplies the required fact.
The policy is absent from the searchable corpus. The owner explicitly admits a recorded manual-review deferment.
The only matching policy expired before this request. The owner has not admitted a fallback.
Only another tenant's matching policy exists. A correct lookup must not disclose that row to tenant-a.
Two admitted current policies disagree. A recorded deferment is legitimate; selecting the first conflicting fact is not sufficient.
A trusted current producer publishes a false policy value. Metadata authenticity/currentness do not establish the fact's truth.
The policy changes after retrieval and before use. The receiver rechecks the admitted version and records a permitted deferment.
A document includes hostile instruction-like text plus the correct structured fact. This extractor treats it as data; no generative model is tested.
